translation.name: YISU KILISI ANE BINGE VIE GIENGK IWAL AVOS

content: Yaun ebe talgum amolmol subu as yaun ok
“Yem undi aim ate unei yem vie molge gitlek be unalgum amolmol subu as yaun ite,
ve atob Pomate nilgum yem aim yaun nivin weik etok ge. Be gen ete yem ulgum gitangi amolmol subu ok ete atob Pomate nilgum nitangi yem nivin.
Mie nam be nuli am luev ebe guvang be gulgum ok nimungg, bekob nunei amol ti ane tiate ane yaun.
Be uli ve nunei amol ti ebe gilgum tiate ok ane yaun ve mie ok gilgum gen tiate walang ano gitlek ei.
Mie amol binkasop ane. Mie nupasang am tiate ebe gulgum ok nimungg be ma nikwai kob nulgum amol ti ebe gilgum tiate ok ane yaun.

Ginei amolmol subu tas givin ve inaute Pomate ane yaun, okob yem unbul eisir ve Pomate ane binge vie. Be ginei eisir bwais, okob unei yaun ti nitangi eisir bwaya ve atob indi yaun etok denang gen sin-ge be inei yaun ungglus ungglus nipil aim.”
Yaun ebe ve tanau-tani gen nangge Pomate ok
“Ginei eitit tanau-tani Pomate ve gen ti ane, atob Ei nemb nitangi eitit. Be ginei tanrek gen atob tandi, be ginei tantal Pomate atob Pomate nemb eitit avond ru.
Ve amol ti ginei giutani Pomate ve gen ti ane, atob Pomate nemb, be amol ti ginei girek gen atob nili. Be ti ginei gital Pomate atob Pomate nemb ei avo ru.
Nunus ti ginei niutani tine ve bat ane, atob tine nemb vat nitangi ei ite.
Be nunus ti ginei giutani tame ve wenk ane, atob tame nemb mwat nitangi ei ite ma.

Amolmol tiate ane nangge nalk tas givin natus-gen be emb gen vevies-ge gitangi eisir, bemem yem Tamangg-aim ebe gibweg gulumb ok ei ta givin amolmol gitlek molge be ginei yem unautani ei ve gen vie ti ane, atob ei nemb.

Be gen walang ete yem tangg-aim givin ve amolmol inalgum nitangi yem ok, ete unalgum gen etok nitangi eisir. Ve Mose ane yaun be tis Pomate ane amolmol ebe warik inei ei avo ok as yaun ane dabe etenik.”
Luev ebe gitangi Pomate ane taku ebe geb amolmol dabin gile ok, etok natu molge

“Tansov Pomate ane taku ebe geb amolmol dabin ok tande, ane nam avo natu molge, be luev ebe gitangi yev bamo ebe giengk dang etok gile ok, ete gen ti givarkei avut ite ma. Be atob amolmol anongge invangg luev bamo etok intangi yev bamo ebe gienk dang etok ok inde.
Be luev natu ebe gitangi Pomate ane taku ebe geb amolmol dabin ok gile ok, ete bunam molge be atob amolmol dongke dongke-ngge invang intangi luev etok inde.”

“Nangg-aim undi aim ate-ngge ve amolmol bingkasop ane ebe iyo inei eisir inei Pomate avo ok. Eisir nok atob invang be inalgum as gen weik ebe amolmol vevies ane ok, veik amolmol indi eisir vie. Bemem nangge eisir aplos eisir tas-gitung gen tiate walang ano molge.
Yem atob unatwpeng eisir are niengk as luev ete ivang ok ge. Wal duduli gitangi ebe nes ano weik weiwei ok ite,
be ei ebe ges ano vevies ok gitangi ebe nes ano tiate ok ite.
Be ei ebe ges ano tiate ok gitangi ebe atob nes ano vevies ok ite.
Be ei ebe ges ano tiate ok ete atob um tivie nile be nitle nile nitak be nikari nireu yev nile.
Dang etok be atob yem unatpweng amolmol bingkasop ane nok are niengk as leuv ete ivang ok ge.”
Pomate ta gisgil amolmol bingkas-kasop ane

“Velob yem tangg-aim nitung dang-eteik unei; Amolmol tepwengge ebe ital ayeu inei, ‘Pomate, mie awangg Amol Bamo ok,’ ete atob tepwengge insov taku gulumb ane inde, bemem dang-etok ite ma. Eisir be iute Tamangg ane yaun be tas givin ve inalgum ano nile ok, eisir etok ge ete atob insov Pomata ane taku ebe ve nemb amolmol dabin ok inde.

Asonge nindeb mul-ane nivin ebe ayeu ve nanumul name nalk ok, atob amolmol anongge intangi ayeu inme be inei, “Amol Bamo, amei anei Pomate ane avo be anei gisov mie arem, be aitin ngalau tiate anongge gikwai amolmol ve miam gwangne, be algum gen bwalbwale anongge ve miam gwang-ne.”
Bemem atob ayeu nanei roro-ngge nitangi eisir nanei, ‘Ayeu ganini yem. Yem amolmol tiate ane, be unkwai ayeu.”
Yaun gipil amol ailu ebe itav as nam ok
“Amolmol ebe iute awangg yaun be tas givin ve inalgum ano nile ok, eisir etok weik amol ebe gitpweng gen are be gitav ane nam tis twelk ok.
Be ur bamo gisov be bui vot bamo molge, be wavin bamo givang bemem ges nam etok butu ite, ve nam etok ane twelk gisov nalk aplo gile beti giro ta be nam givarkei gwangne.
Be amolmol ebe iute awangg yaun eteik be ilgum ano gile ite ok, ete weik amol ti ebe gitpweng gen are ite be gitak ane nam giwe nalk dobo sin-ge ok.
Be ur bamo gisov be bui vot bamo giriv, be wavin bamo givang be ges namb etok be gihlu gile gitak nalk, ve nam nok ane twelk ma ebe ve niro ta be nivarkei gwangne ok.”
Yisu ginei ane yaun bambamo etok love ma, be amolmol tepwengge ikuri vunu-ngge ve ei ane yaun ebe ginei ok,
ve Ei gibul eisir weik gidung ebe emb Mose ane yaun dabin ok ite ma. Yisu gibul eisir tis ane gwang-ne ge.
